method: Fetched committed source, reconstructed byte-identical locally; verified git blob SHA and byte length 2949; executed python stdlib runner on local interpreter; compared 24 trial tuples to pre-existing committed evidence.
preregistered_primary_gate: intervention false acceptance <= baseline false acceptance - 6 and abstention <=12/24
comparison: 24/24 tuples equal to evidence/research/generalization/s3_intervention_v2_local.json; primary summary and hypothesis_accepted equal; CPU differs and is not deterministic
integrity_findings: Source exact Git blob SHA matches PR #51 committed runner; no runner changes.
The test-label inversion diagnostic computes inverted marker errors but does not actually rerun selectors under inverted test labels; therefore it is not a complete holdout-leakage sentinel.
Negative control uses one 0.95-fidelity source and one 0.5-fidelity source, not two no-signal sources; interpreting it as a pure no-signal control would be incorrect.
All splits share the same parity label rule, hence disjoint topologies but not disjoint semantic grammars.
scientific_decision: HOLD: preregistered gate rejected; no promotion; not independent scientific confirmation.
